description: A fuel cost calculator for any drive — your units, your currency, split however you like. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

consumption.description: The vehicle's fuel consumption, in the unit given by consumptionUnit. Note that for mpg a higher number means less fuel, for l/100km more.

consumptionUnit.description: The unit consumption is given in: 'l100km' litres per 100 km, 'mpgUk' miles per imperial gallon, 'mpgUs' miles per US gallon, 'kml' kilometres per litre.

distance.description: The length of the journey one way, in the unit given by distanceUnit.

distanceUnit.description: The unit distance is given in: 'km' kilometres or 'mi' miles.

people.description: How many people share the cost. The total is divided equally between them.

price.description: The price of fuel per unit given by priceUnit, in any currency. The result comes back in the same currency, unconverted.

priceUnit.description: The unit the price is per: 'litre', 'gallonUk' (4.546 l) or 'gallonUs' (3.785 l).

returnTrip.description: Double the distance to cover the journey back as well.

name: fuel_cost_calculator
title: Fuel Cost Calculator
